newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Worldwide closes marine unit sale.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Worldwide closes marine unit sale.

text.p: Johnson Worldwide Associates Inc said Thursday it completed the sale of its Plastimo marine business to an investor group led by a European investment capital firm.
Financial terms were not announced, but Johnson Worldwide said proceeds will be used to reduce its debt.
The company said its fourth quarter results, reported in November, included a non-recurring charge of $4.3 million that included the sale of Platimo, which posted sales of $36 million in fiscal 1996.
Johnson Worldwide makes outdoor recreation products.
